Snackolator on Instagram: "Dunkin' is giving ANOTHER MILLION free coffees away next week and there's no purchase necessary! UPDATE: Still waiting for code to go live...

By using offer "freecoffee1" in the app Dunkin' Rewards members can claim a free coffee to use on 4/21.

As of now it appears this code will go live on April 20th at 9am (guessing eastern time) - I will update if that changes. (The code will show expired until then!) You can claim the offer on the 20th and then use the next day - I don't think the million will last long before they're all claimed! (Still waiting for code to go live....)

Are you grabbing some free @dunkin for next week?

#dunkin #dunkindonuts #freecoffee #freefood #cheapeats"
